_comment: Stage 2: the proposed method. 2x2 factorial (exploration: eps-greedy vs MC-dropout TS) x (selector: EXP3 vs EXP3.S) on top of NB2 and NB3, under the paper's drift protocol, 10 seeds. The EXP3 / eps-greedy cells are nb2 / nb3 from reproduction.json (same folder, not rerun). EXP3.S alpha = 1/T = 4e-7 is pre-declared (Auer et al. 2002); other values are in ablations.json. MC dropout: p=0.1 on networks with >= 25 hidden units, S=4 extra passes for the propensity.

runs.name: nb2_exp3s
runs.note: H2: EXP3.S, alpha = 1/T fixed in advance

runs.note: H2: EXP3.S, alpha = 1/T fixed in advance
